title: Can I BEAT King of the Bridge? (Rules Ending)
summary: Return to King of the Bridge to earn the 'Rule Savant' award by unlocking every rule in the Troll's rule book; only rule 28 is missing. He first tries to beat the Troll without cheating and walk past him at the end (doesn't unlock it), then experiments: castling the king is simply illegal (violates rule 12, the lazy crown guy), and finally moving a 'castle' (a rook placed next to another rook forms a castle) triggers rule 28: 'You are only allowed to move the castles when there are three or more towers in the game', unlocking Rule Savant.
rules: Rule Savant award: unlock all rules in the rule book.
Normal castling is not allowed (king move violates rule 12).
Pawns only move one square at a time (no en passant); promotion is covered by an existing rule.
Rooks placed next to each other form a 'castle'; Rule 28: you may only move the castles when there are three or more towers in the game.
Winning without cheating lets you walk to the end of the bridge (alternative ending path).

Base game rules as in WEYUcaJTBso (King of the Bridge): accusation via Space + rule book; correct accusation = you may cheat once; false accusation = turn forfeited + troll revenge cheat; pawns move orthogonally (forward/back/sideways) not diagonally; only knights jump; only bishops may go 'out of town' off-board; troll king death passes crown to another piece; queen can't take king; slippery tiles; board flips.
win_condition: Unlock rule 28 / all rules -> Rule Savant award.
